d:
First, we speak to The Indian Express’ Amit Kamath from Geneva about the youngest World Chess Championship match in history, as 20-year-old defending champion D Gukesh prepares to face Uzbekistan’s Javokhir Sindarov.
Next, we speak to The Indian Express’ Pragynesh about the growing threat of digital arrest scams and how a specialised Delhi Police team is identifying potential victims and intervening before they lose more money. (14:50)
